patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.chiefComplaint: Agitated, talking a mile a minute
presentation.quote: I feel INCREDIBLE, I haven't slept in three days and I don't need to — my mind is racing with brilliant plans. My family freaked out and dragged me here. I'm fine, better than fine, I just can't sit still.
presentation.triageNote: 36-year-old male with bipolar disorder who has slept very little for three days. He has rapid pressured speech, racing thoughts, grandiose plans, and marked restlessness; he is not violent and has no evident medical instability.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 4 is appropriate because this medically stable nonviolent manic episode requires one specialty psychiatric-evaluation resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient with bipolar disorder has markedly reduced sleep, pressured speech, racing thoughts, grandiosity, and restlessness without violence or evident medical instability.
clinical.acuityReason: The presentation requires safety and psychiatric assessment, while current behavior and physiology do not indicate immediate sedation or medical resuscitation.
keyFindings: Very little sleep for three days
teachingPoints: Safety assessment must include impulsivity, psychosis, suicidality, aggression, judgment, and ability to care for self.
Substance use, thyroid disease, medication effects, and other medical mimics should be considered when appropriate.

possibleDiagnoses: Medical mimic if new findings emerge
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Medical screening and psychiatric assessment would guide medication, observation, and supported discharge or psychiatric admission.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 36-year-old man, energized and restless, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: leaning forward, mid-gesture, animated and restless. Expression: wired and over-bright. Clearly visible: an animated, gesturing, restless posture. No text, no logos.
